newsitem.title: GERMANY: Viag, BT call news conference.
newsitem.headline: Viag, BT call news conference.

text.p: German utility Viag AG and British Telecom Plc on Wednesday called a news conference for 0800 GMT on Thursday after partner utility RWE AG announced it was leaving their strategic alliance.
A Viag spokesman said the companies want to outline their joint strategy to compete with monopoly Deutsche Telekom AG when the German telecommunications sector is deregulated in 1998.
RWE AG had said earlier it would pull out of a telecoms alliance with BT and VIAG over differences in strategy.
RWE said in an ad hoc news announcement it was in the final stage of negotiations with Veba AG and Cable & Wireless on "taking a new direction to enter the German telecommunications market."
Veba also said earlier that the three-way talks were nearing completion. RWE said, however, it would continue to cooperate with VIAG in the area of telecoms infrastructure.
